title: Fungal laccase-guided copper nanoflower assembly enables complete conversion of HMF to FDCA
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29692-29702
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04187B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lei Yang, Anbang Duan, Yuan Ding, Xiquan Song, Qianli Ma, Zhanyin Liu, Tingying Wei, Zhixing Wang, Chunzhao Liu
This study synthesizes laccase-integrated copper hybrid nanoflowers (Lac-NFs) via enzyme–metal self-assembly, enabling complete HMF-to-FDCA conversion while exhibiting enhanced stability, activity retention, and kinetics versus free laccase.
